rule: Every tracked file and folder name is lowercase snake_case: segments of [a-z0-9_] joined by dots for extensions. README.md is the one deliberate exception.

keep_basenames.Cargo.toml: Cargo only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.Cargo.lock: Cargo only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.SKILL.md: the Agent Skills format requires this exact name
keep_basenames.AGENTS.md: agent tools look for this exact name
keep_basenames.CLAUDE.md: Claude Code looks for this exact name
keep_basenames.lean-toolchain: elan only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lake-manifest.json: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lakefile.lean: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.lakefile.toml: Lake only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.FUNDING.yml: GitHub only reads this exact name
keep_basenames.CODEOWNERS: GitHub only reads this exact name

keep_globs.**/*.lean: Lean module names are imports; renaming them rewrites every import and proof
keep_globs.csharp/**: .NET project, namespace and assembly names follow PascalCase
keep_globs.operads/skills/*: a skill folder must match the hyphenated name in its SKILL.md
keep_globs.benchmarks/industry_replacement/industry: a skill folder must match the hyphenated name in its SKILL.md

frozen_bundle_note: A folder holding one of these files is a hash-pinned bundle. Nothing inside it is renamed, so the manifest keeps matching.

rewrite_exclude_globs.papers/**: papers keep their content byte for byte
